captions.detailed: A clip-on desk fan consisting of a beige square housing mounted on a black C-clamp bracket. The front of the housing features a three-blade blue propeller spinning behind a wire grille, while the back has a black hexagonal rotary knob for speed selection. The fan housing can rotate horizontally relative to the clamp bracket, the propeller spins on a central axle, and the rear selector knob rotates to different speed settings.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a clip-on desk fan. The fan should include a square beige housing, a front protective wire grille, a three-bladed blue propeller on a central spinning axis, a rear hexagonal speed knob, and a black C-clamp bracket connected via a swivel joint to allow horizontal rotation.
captions.factory: The code defines a multi-part assembly starting with a main base. It constructs the square housing using box primitives and boolean operations to hollow out the front compartment. The wire grille is built by combining concentric wire rings with radial support cylinders, and the propeller is modeled with a central hub cylinder and three swept/extruded blades. The clamp bracket is created using a U-shaped or C-shaped profile extruded to thickness, coupled with a threaded-style clamping screw. These parts are joined using revolute joints for the swivel mount, the propeller axle, and the rear hexagonal knob.
